name: 江湖风云3
english_description: In-game titled "Sunset Reappears: Storm Rising II," a Jin Yong-themed wuxia mudlib built on jhfy2's map (7,977 of jhfy2's 9,332 files overlap by path) but running it on a different core-system lineage. A full apprenticeship/shopping/mail pass found all three working: new characters can approach a cloned Linghu Chong (`bai huchong`) at Huashan to become a "fifteenth-generation disciple," buy Hami melons from a Xinjiang-frontier peddler and resell them to a Persian merchant at Gaochang, and send working in-game mail through the post office. This archive's own "Peak of the World" cliff-jump scene is word-for-word identical not to jhfy2's "Tianya"-family version but to xajh4gkb (Xiao'ao Jianghu 4, Public Edition) and byte-identical to xyzx (one of the original "Sunset Reappears" releases) — confirming "Sunset Reappears" is a separate code lineage from "Tianya," stitched here onto jhfy2's map. Registration uses a double-password scheme (separate admin/login passwords) unlike jhfy2's single password. Deep testing fixed the project's usual small bug set (a WASM boot-grace-period gate, a misdirected food/water check, debug printf leaks) and also surfaced a new bug class: the "inherit + redundant replace_program()" fatal pattern known from bulletin boards also lurks in the ROOM base class here, affecting roughly 5,591 of this archive's ~9,300 room files (most survive only by an incidental closure-binding side effect) — only a handful of instances plus the room-building tool's own template were fixed; the bulk is documented as a future sweep in AGENTS.md §7.100.
